inspiration: User-provided CoCivium Living Continuity System mockup; image not published by this contract
premise: Visual, video, audio, spatial, diagram, text, timeline and cultural presentations are projections of source-bound semantic objects and relations, not isolated silos.
rules: Visual links resolve to typed edges and destinations; decorative elements need not be nodes.
Media transformations retain parent IDs, licenses, attribution and hashes.
Separate observed facts, interpretations, hypotheses, speculative G_dSide and fiction.
Cultural translations preserve provenance and distinguish localization from universal claims.
Core content remains accessible when audio, motion and rich media are disabled.
Never auto-unmute or raise audible volume merely on scrolling.
Unlicensed, private or unproven media remains HELD.
Inverse graph traversal does not invent reverse causal assertions.
No automatic cross-session sync or independent front adoption is claimed.
fanout_tracks: accessible interactive hero and reduced-motion test
acceptance: One Seed renders as a diagram, media card and accessible text with identical provenance.
Every semantic visual connector exposes its typed relation and source.
Scrolling alone never creates audible playback.
Independent consumer fetches and receipts a public manifest.
Fresh process reconstructs same public head after >24h.
next: Build a data-driven accessible HTML graph using one verified public Seed and typed links, then compare with visual concept.
proof_boundary: Design artifact only; no image binary publication, live orb, independent spawned front, autonomous sync or runtime durability proven.
